newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan hopes for formal aviation talks with US-Koga.
newsitem.headline: Japan hopes for formal aviation talks with US-Koga.

text.p: Japan hopes its bilateral preliminary aviation talks with the United States will lead to more formal discussions, Transport Minister Makoto Koga told reporters on Tuesday.
Preliminary talks between U.S. and Japanese officials will take place on January 10.
Asked what his stance will be going into the preliminary discussions, Koga said he was considering how formal negotiations could begin and if they were to begin, in what way progress could be made.

The United States is calling for an "open skies" accord in many aviation markets of Asia, but Japan argues that there is substantial inequality in air services into the United States and the United States should open its domestic market, which accounts for 30 percent of the world's aviation market.
